newsitem.title: SPAIN: FEK issue 10 bln ptas 15-yr callable step-up bond.
newsitem.headline: FEK issue 10 bln ptas 15-yr callable step-up bond.

text.p: Finnish export credit (FEK) is issuing a 10 billion pesetas 15-year callable step-up matador bond, lead manager and book runner Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in Madrid said.
The issue has two different coupons, at 5.4 percent for the first two years and at 7.30 percent for the following years.
The issue offeris a call to the issuer after the second year, on August 25 1999.
The issue price is 101.50, payable on August 25, 1997, with maturity on August 27, 2012.
Moody's rating is AA1, while Standard & Poor's is AA. Total fees are 1.50 percent.
